heroLead: From the small fixes to the bigger jobs, K&S helps keep your property looking its best and working just as it should.
aboutTitle: Property care with a personal touch.
aboutText: We believe looking after a property should feel straightforward. K&S Property Maintenance is here to make the jobs, fixes and improvements easier, with friendly service and care taken at every step.
reviewsIntro: Share your experience with K&S Property Maintenance. New reviews appear here and contribute to the live customer rating.
contactText: Reach out for a chat about your property or project.
servicesIntro: From routine upkeep to one-off repairs and improvements, get in touch to talk through what your property needs.
serviceHomeText: Everyday repairs and upkeep to keep your home comfortable, safe and in good shape.
serviceRepairsText: Those little jobs on your list, taken care of carefully and with a tidy finish.
serviceImprovementsText: Practical updates and finishing touches that make more of your space.
serviceOutdoorText: We take on selected garden jobs and exterior upkeep, depending on the work needed.
serviceRentalText: Maintenance support to help keep rental homes ready, presentable and cared for.
serviceProjectText: Have something else in mind? Get in touch and tell us what you need help with.
